prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exceptionally polished desktop website design comp, 1536x1024 landscape: a real web layout, edge to edge, no device frame, no browser chrome.

The attached reference images are screenshots of the SAME website's already-built pages. Carry over exactly: the header (script wordmark "Birdcar" at left; nav "How I work", "Selected work", "Writing" and a canary-yellow pill "Book a free Walkthrough →"), the pale daylight ground #edf3f0, near-black ink #0b141a, the heavy tight grotesk (Mona Sans) for all text, white cards with soft offset shadows, white pill tags, canary yellow #f7c848 only on actions and small highlights, and the premium matte isometric miniature render style. Do NOT copy any reference's page content beyond what this prompt names.

This page is "Eight ways work gets stuck": a free field guide from Nick (Birdcar). It names the eight patterns he uses in his Walkthrough reports so an owner can recognize their own week, then book a free Walkthrough. The eight pattern names, exactly: 1 "It runs on remembering", 2 "The same information, typed twice", 3 "Nobody trusts the numbers", 4 "Assembled by hand", 5 "Waiting on a reply", 6 "Only one person knows how", 7 "Waiting on your yes", 8 "The workaround became the process". The visitor's job: recognize a few, read those entries, book a Walkthrough.

STRUCTURE, in reading order (cards on the desk: eight pattern cards laid out on the owner's desk):
1. Header, about 80px, as the reference.
2. First viewport. LEFT (x 80 to 560): headline about 64px across three lines: "Eight ways work gets stuck. Most businesses have a few." A lead at about 20px: "Most of the work that ends up on your desk isn't hard because it's complicated. It's hard in a handful of familiar ways." Then the canary-yellow button "Book a free Walkthrough →".
RIGHT (x 600 to 1536, y 100 to 1024, bleeding right and bottom): the premium matte isometric desk from the second reference (pale oak, green-teal blotter, plant, speckled stone pen cup, open brass birdcage, a small canary). On the blotter lie eight white index cards with 12px radius and soft shadows, loosely fanned in two overlapping rows, each card flat and square to the viewer so it stays readable: a bold ink number at top left and the exact pattern name in bold ink below it. Card 7 "Waiting on your yes" is lifted slightly higher than the others with a deeper shadow, as if just picked up, and the canary stands beside it.
3. Nothing else competes.

ART DIRECTION: one dominant move, the eight cards on the desk; the left column holds still. Premium, adult, precise. Not cute, not a scrapbook, no tape, no pins, no handwriting. No purple, no gradient orbs, no robots, no AI imagery, no stock photos, no numbers or results, no testimonials. Preserve all quoted words exactly. Treat it as a finished, shippable website.
